metadata.title: Report Test Plan Results
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Backfill actual ADO IDs and URLs into the review JSON, add the requirement suite object, regenerate the combined HTML viewer with clickable ADO links, cleanup credentials if created, and display a final summary of all actions taken.

output.description: Updated test-plan-review JSON with ADO IDs, regenerated HTML viewer, final summary displayed

prerequisites: ADO push completed (adoPush data in memory with created/updated IDs)
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Update test-plan-review-{workItemId}.json with actual ADO IDs and URLs for newly created test cases
Add requirementSuite object (id, name, url) to the review JSON
Regenerate combined HTML viewer with updated JSON (now with clickable ADO links)
Cleanup credentials.json if it was created during the push step
Display summary: total TCs created, updated, linked, ADO links for test plan, suites, and individual test cases, any errors encountered
tools: write_file - Update review JSON with ADO IDs
bestPractices: Verify all ADO IDs are populated before regenerating HTML
Include direct clickable URLs to ADO for all created/updated items
Always cleanup credentials.json to avoid leaving PATs on disk
Summary should be scannable: counts first, then links, then errors
Log any IDs that could not be backfilled (e.g., failed creates)

substeps.name: Backfill ADO IDs into review JSON
substeps.description: Update test-plan-review-{workItemId}.json with actual ADO IDs and URLs for created test cases
actions: Read the current test-plan-review-{workItemId}.json
For each newly created test case: add adoId and adoUrl fields from adoPush.createdTestCases
For each updated test case: add/update adoId and adoUrl fields
For skip and obsolete cases: ensure their existing ADO IDs are recorded

substeps.name: Add requirement suite object
substeps.description: Add the requirementSuite details to the review JSON
actions: Add requirementSuite object to the review JSON: id, name, url
Source the data from adoPush.requirementSuiteId and qaConfig
Construct the ADO URL for the requirement suite

substeps.name: Regenerate combined HTML viewer
substeps.description: Regenerate the HTML viewer with updated JSON data including ADO links
actions: Write the updated test-plan-review-{workItemId}.json
Regenerate the combined HTML viewer using combined-viewer.html template
The HTML should now contain clickable ADO links for all items

substeps.name: Open HTML in browser
substeps.description: Open the regenerated HTML viewer for final review
actions: Open .qa/test-plan/test-plan-review-{workItemId}.html in the default browser
Inform user that the final report is available

substeps.name: Cleanup credentials
substeps.description: Remove credentials.json if it was created during the push step
actions: Check if credentials.json was created during the push step (from memory)
If it was created: delete the file to avoid leaving PATs on disk
Log the cleanup action

substeps.name: Display summary
substeps.description: Show a comprehensive summary of all actions taken
actions: Display counts: TCs created, TCs updated, TCs linked (including skip), obsolete actions taken
Display ADO links: test plan URL, target suite URL, requirement suite URL
Display individual test case links: title + ADO URL for each created/updated TC
Display any errors: list any operations that failed with error details
Format for easy scanning: counts first, then links grouped by category, then errors

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: All created test cases have ADO IDs backfilled
Verify: Requirement suite object is present in review JSON
Verify: HTML was regenerated with clickable ADO links
Verify: credentials.json cleaned up if it was created
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Backfill ADO IDs into review JSON -> Add requirement suite object -> Regenerate HTML viewer with ADO links -> Open in browser -> Cleanup credentials.json if created -> Display comprehensive summary with counts, links, and errors.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: adoPush results (created/updated IDs, requirement suite, errors), qaConfig
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: report object with summary, ADO links, and any errors
fields: Information Produced: report.summary (counts of created/updated/linked/obsolete), report.adoLinks (all ADO URLs), report.errors (any failed operations)
Notes: Any IDs that could not be backfilled, final process status
